description: The Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research publishes the input collection required by the HANZE version 2.0 historical-exposure model. Two archives separate raw inputs and prepared products. They support reconstruction of land use, population and economic exposure across 42 European countries for 1870–2020. Zenodo provides the ZIP files publicly and free under CC-BY-4.0. The repository instructs users to unpack both into a common directory and set the main-path variable in the model’s file-location script. Detailed input schemas and their individual resolutions are delegated to the separate model documentation. A limitation is that the landing page alone does not establish each source’s completeness or preprocessing assumptions. These inputs support reproducible exposure simulations and sensitivity experiments with HANZE. They complement the archived model and standard output maps by preserving the material needed to regenerate them. No archive or documentation PDF was downloaded.
